description.value: Megabite Pizza is a BC-based fast-food pizza chain with multiple locations across Greater Vancouver, offering dine-in, takeout, and delivery from a menu spanning pizzas, wings, poutine, and sides. The chain carries vegetarian pizza options and runs a loyalty rewards program for repeat customers. A cycling tourist stopping here would find an accessible indoor space with no outdoor seating.
